elements.name: Apply a feature suppression change through the model-state table

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State
the user sets the extrusion to Suppress in Primary and Capture State and Compute in Copy State through the model-state table
the user activates Copy State
The MCAD Software has an extrusion suppressed in Primary and computed in Copy State
Copy State is active
the active view representation permits the extrusion's solid body to be visible
the user opens the model-state table
changes the Primary extrusion cell to Compute
accepts the table
activates the Primary model state
the solid produced by the extrusion is visible
the user reopens the model-state table
the Primary extrusion cell displays Compute
the user changes the Primary extrusion cell to Suppress and accepts the table
the solid is absent from the viewport
the extrusion row is struck through
the user activates Copy State
the solid is visible again
the extrusion row is no longer struck through
